components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action of a region; gradient pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #126fc1, #0d7f55); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(20, 99, 155, 0.18); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(16, 59, 97, 0.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.22); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; color: #0a4c9c; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(19, 100, 174, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(22, 76, 126, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(16, 59, 97, 0.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.22); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action, always behind a confirmation dialog.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with soft pill-ish shell.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: #56677e; } .ds-field input { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); color: #17304a; font: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.12); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; color: #56677e; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0a4c9c; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.22); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #126fc1, #0d7f55); } .ds-count { min-width: 1.45rem; min-height: 1.45rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; background: rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.14); color: #0a4c9c; }

narrative.overview: MyGlico should feel like a trustworthy, welcoming clinic: trust blue for action and structure, steady green for stability, and nothing that alarms. The system pairs a soft form language (pills, generous 20–30 px corners, translucent white panels over a pale morning-mist background) with precise information: legible numbers, explicit states, and chips that name what is going on. The balance is deliberate. The form welcomes patients who are not technical; the information stays as precise as a clinical panel. Warmth comes from shape and space, never from vague data.
keyCharacteristics: Blue→green action gradient (action-blue → action-green, 135°) reserved for the primary action and the active state; darker stops keep white labels above 4.5:1.
Translucent white panels with a hairline blue border and a diffuse ambient shadow, floating over a pale gradient background.
Pill-shaped controls everywhere (buttons, chips, badges, nav links, pagination).
A condensed geometric display face for headings over a humanist sans body.
Uppercase green eyebrows above every panel heading.

rules.name: The Gradient Means Go Rule
rules.body: The action gradient marks only the main action of a view and the active state (active nav link, active chip, current page). One gradient-filled button per region.

rules.name: The Calm Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber and rose appear as tints with dark text (amber-attention-text, rose-alert-text), never as large fills, except the confirm button of a destructive dialog.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Heading Pair Rule
rules.body: Every panel opens with an eyebrow, then an h2, then an optional one-line description.

dos: Do build every new screen from the panel + eyebrow + h2 structure.
Do use the shared field, button, badge and state primitives instead of inline styles.
Do keep the gradient for one primary action per region and for active states.
Do put destructive actions in the danger style behind a confirmation dialog.
Do show pending or atypical status as a tinted chip with dark text.
donts: Don't ship browser-default inputs, square corners or flat #005fcc buttons; those were the off-system patterns removed in the 2026-10 layout review.
Don't fill large areas with amber or rose.
Don't hardcode colors outside the --react-* tokens; alert text uses --react-rose-text and --react-amber-text.
Don't put white text on the light brand trust-blue/steady-green fills; use the action gradient.
